sentences.zh: 《星际迷航》，当然他也确实喜欢《星际迷航》。

sentences.en: But Dave pitched that it would be cooler if he liked this kind of niche sci-fi thing.
sentences.zh: 但戴夫提议，如果他喜欢这种小众的科幻作品会更酷。

sentences.en: And that is why Dwight came to love Battlestar Galactica.
sentences.zh: 这就是德怀特后来爱上《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》的原因。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Dave said Greg even bought him a model of the original Galactica Cylon base ship for one
sentences.zh: 戴夫说格雷格甚至在他的一次生日时买了一个老版卡拉狄加赛昂母舰模型送给他。

sentences.en: of his birthdays.
sentences.zh: 当他们为这一集做准备时，菲尔·希a问德怀特是要用老版系列的卡拉狄加还是新版系列的卡拉狄加。

sentences.en: And when they were prepping this episode, Phil Shea asked if Dwight would have an original
sentences.zh: 他两个系列都喜欢，但他想要老版的卡拉狄加。

sentences.en: series Galactica or the new series Galactica.
sentences.zh: 当剧集拍摄杀青时，菲尔·希a说他可以留下它并把它送给了他。

sentences.en: He loves both series, but he wanted the original Galactica.
sentences.zh: 雷恩在上面签了名并写道：“戴夫·卡拉狄加爱你。”

sentences.en: And when the show wrapped filming, Phil Shea said that he could keep it and gave it to him.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，这个模型仍然摆在他的办公室里展示着。

sentences.en: And Rain signed it and wrote, Dave Galactica loves you.
sentences.zh: 我们在对进行采访时也看到了它。

sentences.en: And he has it to this day displayed in his office.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到它挂在背景中。

sentences.en: And we saw it when we did our interview with him.
sentences.zh: 话说回来，我当时在想我们是否需要获得特殊许可才能使用这艘飞船。

sentences.en: We could see it hanging in the background.
sentences.zh: 但史蒂夫·伯吉斯说，法务部门说，用吧。

sentences.en: Well, I was wondering if we had to get special permission to use the ship.
sentences.zh: 尽管用。

sentences.en: But Steve Burgess said, legal said, use it.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Just use it.
sentences.zh: 他说我们使用它的方式完全符合其本意。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 就像它本来就是一个用来拼装上色并悬挂的模型。

sentences.en: He said that we were not using it in any way that it was not intended.
sentences.zh: 而我们也就是这么用的。

sentences.en: Like it was a model that you paint and hang.
sentences.zh: 所以没问题。

sentences.en: And that's what we did with it.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们也没有说它的任何坏话。

sentences.en: So it was OK.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也是一部环球公司的剧。

sentences.en: And also, we weren't saying anything bad about it.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And also, it's a universal show.
sentences.zh: 那么，德怀特送埃丝特出门。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 他拿了一个上面写着“现在”的懒人沙发豆袋，朝吉姆的背后扔去。

sentences.en: Well, Dwight shows Esther out the door.
sentences.zh: 召唤袋。

sentences.en: He gets a beanbag that says now on it and throws it at the back of Jim.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个召唤袋。

sentences.en: The summoning bag.
sentences.zh: 他告诉吉姆，他需要他去对一个婴儿进行测试。

sentences.en: Yes, it's a summoning bag.
sentences.zh: 吉姆说：“我今天很忙。”

sentences.en: And he tells Jim he's going to need him to perform a test on a baby.
sentences.zh: 在写字板上写了点东西。

sentences.en: Jim says, I've got a busy day.
sentences.zh: 撕了下来。

sentences.en: Writes something on his clipboard.
sentences.zh: 更多的写字板演技。

sentences.en: Tears it off.
sentences.zh: 然后说：“你知道吗？”

sentences.en: More clipboard acting.
sentences.zh: 他打算把这事推给他的二把手。

sentences.en: And says, you know what?
sentences.zh: 他们甚至吃同一种纸。

sentences.en: He's going to pass this off to his number two.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Unless he can't handle it.
sentences.zh: 除非他应付不来。

sentences.en: And Dwight assures him he can.
sentences.zh: 而德怀特向他保证他可以。

sentences.en: Dun, dun, dun.
sentences.zh: 咚，咚，咚。

sentences.en: To be continued.
sentences.zh: 未完待续。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, there you have it, folks.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，情况就是这样。

sentences.zh: 这就是《AARM》第一部分。

sentences.en: Next week is AARM Part 2.
sentences.zh: 下周是《AARM》第二部分。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢戴夫·罗杰斯。

sentences.en: To Steve Burgess.
sentences.zh: 感谢史蒂夫·伯吉斯。

sentences.en: Jessica St. Clair.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·圣克莱尔。

sentences.en: Don't forget to check out Jessica's audiobook, The Art of Small Talk, available on Audible.
sentences.zh: 别忘了去听听杰西卡的有声书《小闲聊的艺术》，在Audible上架。

sentences.en: And I want to remind everybody that Kendra Adachi's book, The Plan, is out now.
sentences.zh: 我想提醒大家，肯德拉·阿达奇的书《计划》现在已经出版了。

sentences.en: We talked about it last week.
sentences.zh: 我们上周聊过这个。

sentences.zh: 没毛病。

sentences.en: And you guys, we hope you have a great day.
sentences.zh: 各位，希望你们有个美好的一天。

sentences.en: We can't wait to see you next week.
sentences.zh: 我们迫不及待地想在下周见到你们。

sentences.en: We have some really fun stuff coming up.
sentences.zh: 我们有一些非常有趣的内容要推出。

sentences.zh: 到时见。
